pairing: Training-only structural prototypes and geometry descriptors are embedded by canonical-sign3D PCA, standardized per component, and matched one-to-one by minimum total Euclidean distance. This is an engineering association, not a traditional named-pattern rule.
region_boundary: Nearest-prototype Voronoi switch can be discontinuous; no ID/date/label is read.
training_uses: 2550 training structural inputs; no holdout or gallery ODE outcomes
